text.headline: Timeline of Germany
text.text: Major events in the history of Germany.

events.headline: Formation of Germanic Tribes
events.text: Various Germanic tribes begin to form in Central Europe, laying the foundations for future German identity.

events.headline: Battle of the Teutoburg Forest
events.text: Germanic tribes led by Arminius defeat three Roman legions, marking a significant turning point in the Roman expansion into Germania.

events.headline: Charlemagne Crowned Emperor
events.text: Charlemagne is crowned Emperor of the Romans, uniting much of Western Europe and laying the groundwork for the Holy Roman Empire.

events.headline: Foundation of the Holy Roman Empire
events.text: Otto I is crowned as the first Holy Roman Emperor, establishing a political entity that would last for over a millennium.

events.headline: Martin Luther's 95 Theses
events.text: Martin Luther publishes his 95 Theses, sparking the Protestant Reformation and leading to significant religious and political changes in Germany.

events.headline: Thirty Years' War Begins
events.text: The Thirty Years' War begins, a devastating conflict that involves many European powers and leads to significant loss of life and territory in Germany.

events.headline: Peace of Westphalia
events.text: The Peace of Westphalia ends the Thirty Years' War, establishing a new political order in Europe and recognizing the sovereignty of German states.

events.headline: Dissolution of the Holy Roman Empire
events.text: The Holy Roman Empire is dissolved following defeat by Napoleon, leading to the rise of nationalism in the German territories.

events.headline: Unification of Germany
events.text: The German Empire is officially proclaimed in the Hall of Mirrors at Versailles, uniting various German states under Prussian leadership.

events.headline: Start of World War I
events.text: World War I begins with the assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand, leading to Germany's involvement in a global conflict.

events.headline: End of World War I
events.text: World War I ends with the signing of the Armistice, leading to significant political changes in Germany and the abdication of Kaiser Wilhelm II.

events.headline: Treaty of Versailles
events.text: The Treaty of Versailles is signed, imposing heavy reparations and territorial losses on Germany, contributing to economic hardship and political instability.

events.headline: Hitler Becomes Chancellor
events.text: Adolf Hitler is appointed Chancellor of Germany, marking the beginning of the Nazi regime and the rise of totalitarianism.

events.headline: Start of World War II
events.text: Germany invades Poland, triggering World War II and leading to widespread conflict across Europe and beyond.

events.headline: End of World War II in Europe
events.text: Germany surrenders unconditionally, marking the end of World War II in Europe and leading to the division of the country.

events.headline: Foundation of West Germany
events.text: The Federal Republic of Germany (West Germany) is established, marking the beginning of the division of Germany during the Cold War.

events.headline: Foundation of East Germany
events.text: The German Democratic Republic (East Germany) is established, solidifying the division of Germany into two separate states.

events.headline: Construction of the Berlin Wall
events.text: The Berlin Wall is erected, symbolizing the division between East and West Germany and the broader Cold War tensions.

events.headline: Fall of the Berlin Wall
events.text: The Berlin Wall falls, leading to the reunification of Germany and the end of the Cold War division.

events.headline: Reunification of Germany
events.text: Germany is officially reunified, marking the end of the division that lasted for over four decades.

events.headline: Germany Adopts the Euro
events.text: Germany adopts the Euro as its official currency, becoming part of the European monetary union.

events.headline: European Migrant Crisis
events.text: Germany plays a significant role in the European migrant crisis, accepting a large number of refugees and migrants fleeing conflict and persecution.

events.headline: COVID-19 Pandemic
events.text: Germany implements measures to combat the COVID-19 pandemic, impacting public health and the economy significantly.
